query: Uganda Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak 2026 latest confirmed case count July 2026, any new case after 20 cumulative
answer:
I've completed the research. Here is a summary of the key findings:

**Uganda Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) Outbreak — Status as of 27 July 2026:**

- **Uganda case count is stable at 20 cumulative confirmed cases**, with **2 deaths** and **18 recoveries** — cross-validated across WHO (DON613, 17 July), ECDC (updated 27 July), and Uganda's Ministry of Health.
- **No new case has been reported beyond the cumulative 20.** The last confirmed Uganda case was on **21 June 2026**.
- Uganda **discharged its last confirmed patient on 16 July 2026** at Mulago National Referral Hospital, Kampala, starting the WHO-mandated **42-day countdown** to declaring the outbreak over. If uninterrupted, this would end **~27–28 August 2026**; any new confirmed case would reset the clock.
- All 20 Uganda cases were in **Kampala District** (15 imported from DRC, 5 secondary), with **no community transmission**.
- Regional context: the epicenter DRC reported **3,200 confirmed cases and 1,405 deaths** (data to 25 July), and the epidemic — a WHO PHEIC since 16 May 2026 — was described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record.

**Direct answer to the forecasting question:** As of the latest reporting (27 July 2026), Uganda has NOT recorded any new confirmed case after the cumulative 20, and is in active surveillance during its 42-day countdown.
